definition: Work must be built in defined phases/stages or a mandated sequence of operations.
trigger_phrases: Phase 1 / Phase 2 | stage construction | sequence of operations | shall be completed before | construction staging
example_from_plans: SAP 032: two-phase construction shown on plans

definition: Aggressive completion deadline, short working window, or interim milestone dates.
trigger_phrases: completion date | calendar days | interim completion | working days | substantial completion by
example_from_plans: Watonwan: intermediate completion dates; duration spans two construction seasons (7/10/23-6/1/24)

definition: Calendar-restricted work windows, often tied to species/weather/agency rules.
trigger_phrases: April 15 to October 31 | in-water work window | no work between | seasonal restriction
example_from_plans: 08MQ: NLEB seasonal restriction Apr 15-Oct 31 near structure | Yankton: Lewis & Clark Rec Area work must finish within 180 days

definition: Required night, weekend, or off-peak work hours.
trigger_phrases: night work | nighttime operations | work between 9 PM and | off-peak hours
example_from_plans: Otter Tail: no work after dark (off highway before dark); no work after 3 PM Saturdays; no work July 3

definition: Complex maintenance-of-traffic: detours, live adjacent traffic, lane closures, urban/noise constraints.
trigger_phrases: maintenance of traffic | detour | lane closure | flagger | adjacent to live traffic | noise ordinance
example_from_plans: Brookings: pilot car required at all times during mainline paving; flaggers at both ends + all intersections

definition: Endangered/protected species protections that constrain timing or methods.
trigger_phrases: Northern Long-Eared Bat / NLEB | whooping crane | ESA | roosting habitat | stop work if sighted
example_from_plans: 08MQ: NLEB roosting + whooping-crane stoppage requirement | Yankton: NLEB restrictions on SD Hwy 52 project

definition: Water-resource permitting and groundwater control: Section 404, SWPPP, dewatering, invasive-species (AIS) decontamination.
trigger_phrases: dewatering | groundwater elevation | Section 404 | SWPPP | temporary discharge permit | AIS decontamination
example_from_plans: 08MQ: box-culvert dewatering (groundwater 1442.04), AIS hot-water wash + 7-day dry

definition: Cultural/historic-resource obligations that gate or constrain construction.
trigger_phrases: Section 4(f) | NRHP | Memorandum of Agreement / MOA | SHPO | archaeological | adverse effect
example_from_plans: 08MQ: NRHP-eligible historic bridge, MOA stipulations before construction | Yankton: Lewis & Clark Rec Area Section 4(f)/6(f), no staging in rec area

definition: Existing utilities in the work zone requiring avoidance, potholing, or relocation.
trigger_phrases: high pressure gas line | utility relocation | potholing | fiber optic | overhead power | Gopher State One Call
example_from_plans: SAP 032: Enterprise Products high-pressure gas line in project limits

definition: Box culverts, bridges, structure removal/replacement, or retaining/MSE walls in scope.
trigger_phrases: box culvert | bridge replacement | structure removal | MSE wall | thru-truss | RCBC
example_from_plans: SAP 032: box culvert at STA 62+68 (15° skew) | 08MQ: steel thru-truss removal + new RCBC over Wolf Creek

definition: Large cut/fill imbalance or borrow/waste sourcing the contractor must resolve.
trigger_phrases: excavation vs embankment | borrow | waste site | surplus excavation | import fill
example_from_plans: SAP 032: 94,652 CY excavation vs 76,750 CY embankment

definition: Plans flag unknowns the contractor inherits: no survey data, do-not-disturb features.
trigger_phrases: no survey data available | do not disturb | location approximate | field verify | utilities not located
example_from_plans: SAP 032: judicial ditches & bridges with no survey data, do-not-disturb

definition: Real work shifted onto the contractor with no direct pay item: 'incidental', 'by others' coordination, or owner-furnished material the contractor must place.
trigger_phrases: incidental to the contract | by others | furnished by the County | placed by Contractor | no separate payment
example_from_plans: SAP 032: county-supplied geogrid placed by contractor (incidental); 3,000 CY topsoil stockpile | Walsh: millings hauled to owner-designated pit 5 mi W of Pisek ND at contractor expense

definition: Aggregate-quality spec driving source choice (traffic level, pit vs quarry) or owner-controlled material source.
trigger_phrases: traffic level 4 | fractured faces | crushed quarry rock | aggregate from County pit | material source

definition: Federal Davis-Bacon and/or state prevailing-wage rates apply (raises labor cost).
trigger_phrases: Davis-Bacon | prevailing wage | wage determination | certified payroll | minimum wage rate
example_from_plans: 00 Prosoal: federal Davis-Bacon + MnDOT prevailing wage provisions

definition: Disadvantaged/Women's Business Enterprise participation goal or good-faith effort.
trigger_phrases: DBE goal | good faith effort | WBE | disadvantaged business

definition: High liquidated-damages / disincentive rate for late completion.
trigger_phrases: liquidated damages | $ per calendar day | disincentive | road user costs

definition: Compaction density-lot failure penalties / price-reduction or removal clauses.
trigger_phrases: density lot | lot will be rejected | price reduction for density | remove and replace | longitudinal joint density
example_from_plans: Walsh: longitudinal joint-density pay-adjustment penalty clause

definition: Mandatory coordination with other contractors, agencies, railroads, or landowners.
trigger_phrases: coordinate with | adjacent contract | railroad flagger | notify landowner | by separate contract
example_from_plans: SAP 032: coordinate topsoil stockpile + geogrid with Jackson County

definition: Heightened QC / testing / certified-personnel or inspection hold-point burden.
trigger_phrases: quality control plan | certified technician | inspection hold point | independent assurance | required testing | intelligent compaction
example_from_plans: Dunn: Intelligent Compaction required for HMA (SP-2); High Friction Surface Treatment provision
